author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Portal: The Flash Version

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friends. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host clicks the menus. The next chamber starts when everyone is through the exit; one death restarts it for everyone.

keys.does: Aim; click shoots a portal (blue and orange in turn).
Shoot blue or orange; R closes both.
Pick up or drop a box.

tips: Two players is the game as meant; up to four fit in every chamber.
A portal can't land on top of another player's: talk to each other.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.
New: not yet played by people on two PCs or over the internet. Tell us how it runs.

description: Portal: The Flash Version (We Create Stuff, 2007): solve 41 test chambers as a team. Everyone has their own test subject, crosshair and pair of portals, and anyone can go through anyone's portals.
